note: Derivation constants for the Two Buyers simulator. Every figure traces to the fact registry; the simulator is denominated in the Duke study's own units (2019 dollars) and never invents interest rates or period payment schedules. The audit recomputes these invariants.

rossExample.note: Clyde Ross's documented case ran worse than the study's 84 percent average markup.

twoBuyers.equityRule: The contract side holds zero equity until the final payment clears; the conventional side accrues a share of the house proportional to months elapsed over the term. The conventional share is rendered as a fraction, never as an invented dollar amount.
twoBuyers.evictionRule: One LIFE HAPPENS event per session. On the contract side it forfeits everything paid and relists the house; on the conventional side the family sells or refinances and keeps its accrued share.
